title: Earth 1,07,000 km/h se bhaag rahi hai. Feel kyun nahi hota?
description: Season 2 Episode 7: You only feel *changes* in speed — constant motion is invisible (Newton's first law).
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (Newton's 1st law, inertia, Galileo)
hook_text: Tum abhi 1,07,000 km/h se ja rahe ho 🌍💨
concept: You only feel *changes* in speed — constant motion is invisible (Newton's first law).
on_screen_cues: "Earth: 107,000 km/h around Sun" → plane + chai cup → "Feel = CHANGE in speed" → "Newton's 1st Law · NCERT XI Ch 4" → "Voyager 1 · 1977 · 17 km/s"
pinned_comment: Agar Earth achanak RUK jaaye toh tumhare saath kya hoga? 😱 (Hint: 1,07,000 km/h)
suggested_titles: "Earth 1 lakh km/h se bhaag rahi hai — tumhe feel kyun nahi hota?" / "Newton ka first law — Voyager 50 saal se bina engine"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, Earth 1 lakh kilometre per hour se Sun ke chakkar laga rahi hai...
Chintu: [excited] 1 lakh 7 hazaar. Haan.
Gudiya: [confused] Toh hum ud kyun nahi jaate? Hawa ka jhonka bhi nahi lagta?
Chintu: [mischievously] Plane mein baithe ho, 900 kilometre per hour. Chai giraate ho... kahan girti hai?
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Seedha neeche... cup mein.
Chintu: [cheerfully] Peeche kyun nahi udti?
Gudiya: [surprised] Hmm... kyunki chai bhi plane ke saath 900 se chal rahi hai!
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Tum, hawa, samandar, chai... sab Earth ke saath 1 lakh se chal rahe hain. Sab SAATH mein.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh feel kab hota hai?
Chintu: [excited] Sirf jab speed BADLE! Brake lage, ya mudo. Constant speed kabhi feel nahi hoti!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Matlab chalti hui cheez chalti rehti hai... jab tak koi rokta nahi?
Chintu: [proudly] Yahi Newton ka FIRST LAW hai. Inertia.
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Proof?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Voyager 1. 1977 mein launch hua. Engine band. Aaj bhi 17 kilometre per second se ja raha hai... bina fuel ke.
Gudiya: [gasps] Almost 50 saal se bina engine?!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Space mein rokne wala koi nahi. Toh chalta rahega. Hamesha.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh Newton ka second law? Mera weight 60 kg hai... yeh toh sahi hai na?
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong! Woh next video mein!
